title: CLI command with focused tests
purpose: Create or update one local Samantha CLI command with parser coverage, focused core tests, and deterministic verification.
useWhen: The task adds or changes one Samantha CLI command.
The command is local and explicit, with no daemon, remote adapter, dashboard, or routine trigger scope.
The implementation can be verified with typecheck and Bun tests.

task.title: Implement <command> CLI command
task.instructions: Add the smallest local <command> CLI command implementation that satisfies this task. Use references/playbooks/cli-core-command-with-tests.md as advisory guidance when the run evidence matches; it is not a hard gate and does not broaden worker authority. Start with parser coverage in tests/cli.test.ts and focused core behavior tests in tests/<module>.test.ts. Keep the command explicit and local-only. Do not add remote adapters, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, routine triggers, hidden memory, or promoted learning artifact edits.
